title: Staying on the Bus
coreMove: Patient endurance turns finitude into focus: stay past the first itch to quit, work in small sessions, and let your route diverge through time.

exampleSpecs.domain: art history seminar at a museum
exampleSpecs.audience: students who confuse first impressions with seeing
exampleSpecs.stakes: a thin report may replace real perception
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: show Roberts-style slow looking after the first urge to leave

exampleSpecs.stakes: a promising line of work may be abandoned too soon
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: use the bus station image to keep a route alive

exampleSpecs.audience: leaders who wait for heroic blocks of time
exampleSpecs.stakes: a needed plan keeps slipping into emergency work
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: replace rescue sessions with a small recurring practice

exampleSpecs.stakes: a clever first line may hide a better late detail
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: let late observation revise the first judgment

exampleSpecs.audience: makers tempted to disown derivative work
exampleSpecs.stakes: launch pressure may turn resemblance into premature shame
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: own the derivative stretch without quitting

exampleSpecs.audience: project leads buried under urgent email
exampleSpecs.stakes: the archive may remain a wish instead of a file with pages
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: make one small session visible before email takes the day
